name: Social Media Intelligence (SOCMINT)
description: Collecting and analyzing intelligence from social media platforms and online communities. Covers account discovery, content analysis, network mapping, sentiment analysis, and monitoring for security-relevant information such as credential leaks, insider threats, or brand impersonation across platforms.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to social media intelligence techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the intelligence value of social media and the ethical and legal constraints on collection
evidence: Can describe the types of intelligence obtainable from major social platforms
Understands platform terms of service and legal boundaries for SOCMINT
Aware of the risks of attribution and sock puppet detection

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs basic social media research and monitoring under supervision
evidence: Discovers and documents target accounts across multiple platforms under guidance
Uses platform-native search and third-party tools for content discovery
Collects and preserves social media evidence with proper documentation
Results reviewed by authorized personnel for completeness and ethical compliance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts social media intelligence collection and analysis
evidence: Builds comprehensive social media footprints for targets across 3+ engagements
Maps social networks and identifies key relationships and influence patterns
Monitors social channels for security-relevant disclosures (credential leaks, insider threats)
Produces social media intelligence reports that pass QA review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex SOCMINT operations; develops monitoring capabilities; mentors analysts
evidence: Conducts cross-platform correlation to de-anonymize accounts or link personas
Develops automated monitoring and alerting pipelines for social media sources
Analyzes disinformation campaigns and coordinated inauthentic behavior
Mentors junior analysts on SOCMINT tradecraft and operational security

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines SOCMINT methodology; develops novel techniques; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's social media intelligence methodology
Develops novel techniques for cross-platform persona analysis
Publishes research on SOCMINT methods or platform analysis
Trains teams on social media intelligence tradecraft and tool development

assessment_methods.description: Given a target persona, build a comprehensive social media footprint and relationship map using open sources
Review social media intelligence reports for analytical rigor, source reliability assessment, and ethical compliance
